audit_notes: AUDIT FAILED - REQUEST PHYSICALLY IMPOSSIBLE (same finding as for the previous concept). The user requirement - net permanent heat output > heat input (efficiency > 300 %) from a completely closed, adiabatic system with no energy input, used to heat a house - violates the first law of thermodynamics (perpetuum mobile of the first kind). No choice of bionic concept or parameters can satisfy it, so re-mining further concepts will not resolve this failure. Technical check of the proposed SUBSTITUTE (open system, solar-driven polar-bear-fur transparent insulation + massive wall): parameters physically plausible and positive (wall 0.3 m, k=1.5 W/mK concrete, q=100 W/m3, T_abs=313 K, T_room=293 K). Source coefficient q L^2/k = 6.0 K. Analytical solution T(x)=T_abs+(T_room-T_abs)x+3x(1-x); heat flux into the room -k/L dT/dx(1) = 1.5*23/0.3 = 115 W/m2, absorber-side flux 1.5*17/0.3 = 85 W/m2 into the wall; the balance equals q*L = 30 W/m2 absorbed solar, i.e. energy is conserved and efficiency relative to solar input is < 100 %. Concrete is far below its thermal limits at 313 K; no structural issue. The substitute is valid only as an open system with solar input and does NOT satisfy the stated closed-adiabatic, >300 % requirement. Recommendation: stop and inform the user that the request is impossible; offer open-system alternatives (heat pump COP 3-5 using ambient heat, passive solar wall).
